name: ST-VQA
intro: ST-VQA是面向场景文字理解的视觉问答数据集，包含来自7个公开视觉数据集的23,038张图像和31,791组问答，答案始终依据图像中的文字。挑战按每图词典、3万词全局词典和开放词典定义三档任务。
org: Computer Vision Center, UAB, IIIT Hyderabad
build_method: 公开图像聚合, 众包问答标注, 人工验证
eval_feature: 场景文字读取, 三档词典约束, 编辑距离评分
build_method_en: Public Image Aggregation, Crowdsourced QA Annotation, Human Validation
eval_feature_en: Scene-text reading, Three dictionary regimes, Edit-distance scoring
intro_en: ST-VQA is a scene-text visual question answering dataset with 23,038 images from seven public vision datasets and 31,791 question-answer pairs whose answers are grounded in image text. Its challenge defines per-image, 30k global, and open-dictionary tasks.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with ST-VQA arXiv:1905.13648 Sections 3-4, ICDAR competition arXiv:1907.00490, and official RRC challenge 11 task definitions. ST-VQA combines 23,038 natural images from seven public vision datasets with 31,791 question-answer pairs. Images are selected to contain scene text, then crowd workers write questions whose answers are grounded in that text and the annotations are validated. The challenge publishes train and test data and defines three increasingly difficult settings: a small per-image answer dictionary, one shared 30,000-word dictionary built from roughly 22,000 ground-truth words plus 8,000 distractors, and an open-dictionary end-to-end task. All three are evaluated with Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity, which gives partial credit for OCR-like edit errors and zeroes similarities below the official threshold.
